decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (791/204 C, 791/206 C Received 28/04/2011, 791/205 A Received 01/04/2011, 791/200 B, 791/202 B, 791/203 B Received 23/02/2011 and 791/201, 791/207 Received 02/02/2011) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - This consent does not permit the demolition or dismantling of any part of the building, or the removal of any internal feature, floor, wall or ceiling surface, except in so far as the alterations and extension hereby approved necessitate the removal of certain parts of the existing structure as specifically shown on the approved drawings.
description: Listed Building Consent to widen the opening in the brick wall fronting Park Road to create a vehicular access and install new timber gates; and to widen an opening in the existing brick garden wall to the rear together with installation of replacement timber gates in the wall fronting the Syon Park driveway
